description: This file defines in-memory repository classes and a Unit of Work abstraction for managing User, Test, and Submission models, including demo data seeding.

classes.name: InMemoryBaseRepository
classes.description: A generic in-memory repository providing CRUD operations and filtering.

classes.name: InMemoryUserRepository
classes.description: Repository for User objects with additional methods for lookup by email and role.

classes.name: InMemoryTestRepository
classes.description: Repository for Test objects with methods to list by author and published status.

classes.name: InMemorySubmissionRepository
classes.description: Repository for Submission objects with analytics helpers like average score and top scores.

classes.name: InMemoryUnitOfWork
classes.description: A simple unit of work pattern holding repositories and providing demo data seeding.

methods.name: seed_demo_data
methods.description: Seeds repositories with sample users, a test, and a submission for development/testing.
